name: D × V × F > R
subtitle: Dissatisfaction times Vision times First Steps must be greater than Resistance
summary: An interactive app that scores Dissatisfaction, Vision, First steps, and Resistance for a change you name. You leave knowing whether the change can happen, and which factor is at zero. Useful when a change is stalling and you need to see why.

posts.title: How to be a Secret Agent (of Change)
